headword: {悪口雑言|あっこうぞうごん}
gloss: all manner of abuse; torrent of insults

definitions.gloss: all manner of abuse; torrent of insults; stream of invective
definitions.explanation: A barrage of abusive language and insults. A four-character compound (四字熟語) that emphasizes the indiscriminate and relentless nature of the verbal attacks.

examples.japanese: {悪口雑言|あっこうぞうごん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{浴|あ}びせる。
examples.english: To hurl a torrent of insults at someone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{酔|よ}う→酔う：14437_you⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{悪口雑言|あっこうぞうごん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まらなく→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When he gets drunk, his stream of insults doesn't stop.

examples.japanese: ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦{上|じょう}→〜上：30365_jou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{悪口雑言|あっこうぞうごん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{連|つら}ねる⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{許|ゆる}されない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧。
examples.english: The act of writing endless streams of abuse online is not acceptable.

notes: A four-character compound (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) combining {悪口|あっこう} (slander, bad-mouthing) and {雑言|ぞうごん} (abusive language). Note the reading: {悪口|あっこう} here uses the on'yomi, not the more common kun'yomi ⟦{悪口|わるくち}→悪口：03794_warukuchi⟧ (speaking ill of someone). The compound conveys a more intense, literary tone than ⟦{悪口|わるくち}→悪口：03794_warukuchi⟧ alone. Common collocation: {悪口雑言|あっこうぞうごん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{浴|あ}びせる (to shower someone with abuse).
